users.title: Users & access
users.subtitle: Each user gets their role's access, plus any changes you make for them.

otp.title: One-time password for {{staffId}}
otp.message: Give this password to the user. It's shown only once; they must choose their own at first sign-in.
otp.label: One-time password

access.selfRole: You can't change your own role.
access.legend: Light ticks come from the role. Ticks marked ● are changes for this user only.
access.applies: Changes apply on {{name}}'s next request. If signed in, their menu updates within 30 seconds.

reset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
reset.message: They are signed out everywhere and get a one-time password to choose a new one.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.message: They are signed out everywhere and can't sign in until reactivated.

activate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
activate.message: They can sign in again with their existing password.

screens.title: Screen configuration
screens.subtitle: Turn screens on or off, choose what each one allows, and set their order in the menu.
screens.adminOnly: Admin screens are always on and only for administrators.
screens.legend: V view · C create · E edit · D delete · A approve · X export · P view PII
screens.disableMessage_one: It disappears from the menu for {{count}} user and its API starts returning 403.
screens.disableMessage_other: It disappears from the menu for {{count}} users and its API starts returning 403.
screens.maxHelp: The API never returns more rows than this
